title: Optimism Repeated Contract Router-Like Wallet
description: Optimism Layer 2 case showing extremely concentrated single-contract, single-selector transaction behavior.

dataset_notes.source: BigQuery export from Google Cloud Blockchain Analytics

curation_notes.narrative: This wallet is dominated by one contract destination and one function selector across a very large transaction volume. It is useful for demonstrating how repeated contract-centric behavior can look operational or infrastructural rather than automatically suspicious.
curation_notes.selection_basis: Selected because it showed 100% dominant contract share, 100% dominant function selector share, high transaction count, and low counterparty diversity relative to total activity.
